questions.stem: Why do germinating seeds have a higher rate of respiration than dormant seeds?

options.text: Because dormant seeds do not contain any food stores
Because germinating seeds need more energy for growth and cell division
Because dormant seeds carry out photosynthesis instead
Because germinating seeds absorb more carbon dioxide

questions.explanation: Germinating seeds are actively growing and dividing, which requires a lot of energy. This energy comes from increased aerobic respiration, breaking down stored food reserves much faster than in dormant seeds.
